solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Live on periphery?

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in a business letter
the side of something is its edge or periphery

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether living on the outskirts counts as living at all.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside somewhere is to dwell or make one's home there, a synonym for live.

clue.text: Scarlet grabs mine, but it's handed back

indicators.note: the colour clutches the mine piece, holding it inside

parts.note: scarlet is a shade of red
a mine of information is a store or rich supply

explanation.surface: A redhead snatches what is mine, but then returns it.
explanation.definitionFit: Restored means returned to its owner, the same past participle sense as handed back.

clue.text: Entertainer among travellers in a train

indicators.note: the letters are found amid the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A performer travels with other passengers on a railway carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank Sinatra was an American singer and actor, a celebrated entertainer.

clue.text: Decaying or bad meat hunk

indicators.note: decaying matter breaks down, so the letters fall apart and recombine

explanation.surface: A chunk of rotting or spoilt meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hunk' seems to continue the meat picture, a lump of it, but it means a handsome man.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamboat is a very attractive man, the slang sense of a hunk.

clue.text: Cherished peregrination in P&O cruise

indicators.note: a peregrination is a wandering journey, so the letters travel about into a new order

explanation.surface: A treasured memory of a long voyage aboard a P&O liner.
explanation.walkthrough: P&O is a British shipping and cruise line; its two letters join CRUISE as the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Something precious is dearly loved, a synonym for cherished.

clue.text: Management goes for temporary patching up

parts.note: the running of a business is its management
to repair to a place is to go there

explanation.surface: The bosses resort to quick fixes.
explanation.definitionFit: Running repairs are minor fixes done while something stays in use, a stopgap mend.

clue.text: Pipe radius used in Shard

indicators.note: the radius is put to use inside the shard word

parts.note: a chip is a small broken fragment, a shard
r is the symbol for radius in geometry

explanation.surface: A pipe of a certain radius installed in the Shard, the London skyscraper.
explanation.walkthrough: The Shard is a tall glass tower in London; here it is just a fragment.
explanation.definitionFit: To pipe is to make a high bird-like sound, as does a chirp.

clue.text: Folding stuff and cheque backing mate in France

indicators.note: backing up means going backwards, so the letters run in reverse

parts.note: a giro is a British state benefit cheque or bank transfer
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: Banknotes and a cheque endorsed by a French friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Folding stuff' is slang for paper money, but here it means the art of folding.
explanation.definitionFit: Origami is the Japanese art of paper folding, literally stuff that is folded.

clue.text: Heavy fabric just the thing to pack uniform

indicators.note: the word for uniform is filled with the thing, which goes inside

parts.note: uniform means unvarying, the same
it can mean the ideal thing, as in 'that's it'

explanation.surface: A thick cloth is ideal for packing a uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Samite is a rich, heavy silk fabric of the Middle Ages, often woven with gold.

clue.text: Compress neatly, if perversely, to put limits on freedom

indicators.note: doing something perversely means doing it in a contrary, mixed-up way

explanation.surface: Packing things tidily, oddly enough, can feel restricting.
explanation.definitionFit: To cramp someone's style is an idiom for inhibiting them, curbing their liberty.

clue.text: Sensible to retain hospital doctor in council

indicators.note: one word holding on to another means the second sits inside the first

parts.note: a sensible person is sane
H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
Dr is the abbreviated title of a doctor

explanation.surface: A council is praised for wisely keeping a hospital doctor on its staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word before the definition but supplies the final IN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sanhedrin was the supreme judicial and religious council of ancient Jerusalem.

clue.text: One gets over wearing stupid expression

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: the word stupid has the over put on like a garment, so it goes inside

parts.note: dim means slow-witted or stupid
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over on a scorecard

explanation.surface: Someone recovers from having to wear something silly.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is a fixed phrase whose meaning is not literal, a kind of expression.

clue.text: Model wants time with single mother put to work

indicators.note: the time, single and mother pieces are placed next to work, after it

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work
I is the Roman numeral one, a single
mum is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A model needs time off to cope with being a single mother who goes out to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put to work' reads as a phrase about employment, but 'work' is OP and 'put to' attaches the rest after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The optimum is the best possible case, an ideal model to aim for.

clue.text: Admission of espionage is fix

parts.note: I'm is a confession, as in owning up to being something
a plant is a spy placed inside an organisation

explanation.surface: A spy confesses, and the confession is treated as a stitch-up.
explanation.walkthrough: Together the pieces read 'I'm plant', a confession that one is a spy.
explanation.definitionFit: To implant something is to fix it firmly in place, as a surgeon embeds a device.

clue.text: Returned books are an inspiration

indicators.note: returned books go back, so the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a collection of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Library books brought back prove to be inspiring.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is the Muse of lyric and love poetry, and a Muse is a source of a poet's inspiration.

clue.text: Instrument to stamp fine material

parts.note: an organ is a keyboard musical instrument
a die is a tool for stamping coins or patterns

explanation.surface: A tool used to press a pattern into delicate cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Organdie is a sheer, stiff cotton muslin, a fine fabric.

clue.text: Drug agent is above suspicion in plant

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces sit above the later one

parts.note: a narc is an American narcotics officer
sus is British slang for suspicion, as in the old sus laws

explanation.surface: An undercover narcotics officer is beyond reproach while planted somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' suggests a spy planted in a gang, but it is the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcissus is a genus of bulb flowers including the daffodil.

clue.text: Corrupt banker is Busby

indicators.note: corrupted text is garbled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A crooked financier turns out to be someone named Busby.
explanation.walkthrough: Busby looks like a surname; it is the tall fur hat worn by British guardsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: A bearskin is the tall fur cap of the Guards, commonly though loosely called a busby.

clue.text: Beauty-lover worried about short woman

indicators.note: the worry word goes round the outside of the shortened woman

parts.note: ate in the sense of gnawed at, as in 'what's eating you?'

indicators.note: a short name has its last letter lopped off

parts.note: Esther is a woman's name

explanation.surface: An admirer of beauty frets over a woman who is not tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' looks like a description of the woman, but it cuts the R from ESTHER.
explanation.definitionFit: An aesthete is someone with a refined appreciation of art and beauty.

clue.text: Ruler in mood beheaded soldiers

indicators.note: beheading removes the first letter

parts.note: a temper is a state of mind or mood
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A sovereign in a foul temper executes his troops.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is the sovereign of an empire, a supreme ruler.

clue.text: Gym in Parisian street generates money

indicators.note: the gym piece is placed inside the French street

parts.note: rue is French for street
PE is physical education, school gym lessons

explanation.surface: A gym on a Paris street turns out to be a money-maker.
explanation.definitionFit: The rupee is the currency of India and several neighbouring countries.

clue.text: Lumumba say in power over a very short time

indicators.note: in a down clue power sits above the rest

parts.note: P is the symbol for power in physics
in a trice means in an instant

explanation.surface: The Congolese leader holds power but only briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: Patrice Lumumba was the first prime minister of the independent Congo, removed within months; 'say' marks him as one example of the name.
explanation.definitionFit: The given name of Lumumba is an example of this first name, hence 'say'.

clue.text: Entertaining person news boss booked

parts.note: a card is a witty or amusing person
ed is short for editor, the boss of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor reserved a lively performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'booked' suggests reserving, but here it is a footballer being shown a card.
explanation.definitionFit: A player carded by the referee is booked, shown a yellow card for a foul.

clue.text: Hopes when religious right embraces void

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
pi is informal for pious or religious

indicators.note: a voided word is emptied of its contents, leaving only the outside letters

explanation.surface: Someone wishes for something as the religious right takes up an empty cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embraces' looks like a containment indicator, but 'void' empties it to ES.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is to have ambitions, so the third-person form matches the verb hopes.

clue.text: Thinker was his god at Russell's instigation

indicators.note: the instigation of a thing is its start, so take the opening letter

parts.note: Odin is the chief god of Norse mythology

explanation.surface: A philosopher's deity, adopted on Bertrand Russell's urging.
explanation.walkthrough: Russell and 'Thinker' point to philosophy, but The Thinker is a famous sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: Auguste Rodin sculpted The Thinker, so that statue was his work.

clue.text: Flyer sees V1 in two areas approaching hill

indicators.note: the hill comes up next, joining on at the end
the numeral goes inside the two areas

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for area, so two of them give a pair
V1 read as Roman numerals is five and one, VI
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A pilot spots a wartime V1 flying bomb over two regions near a hill.
explanation.walkthrough: The V1 was a German flying bomb in WWII; here it is just the numerals VI.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator is a pilot, someone who flies aircraft.

clue.text: US lawyer, target for McCarthy, took risks

parts.note: a DA is a district attorney, an American prosecutor
Senator Joseph McCarthy hunted suspected communists, called Reds

explanation.surface: An American attorney was in the sights of the 1950s anti-communist witch-hunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Dared means ventured or had the nerve, the same as taking risks in the past tense.

clue.text: Standard credit to extend Jamaican homes

indicators.note: the credit word is added on to lengthen the homes

parts.note: in Jamaican usage a yard is one's home
tick is British slang for credit, as in buying on tick

explanation.surface: A benchmark loan scheme to enlarge housing in Jamaica.
explanation.definitionFit: A yardstick is a measure for comparison, a standard to judge by.

clue.text: Called into action and driven mad

indicators.note: the call goes inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
rang means telephoned or called

explanation.surface: Someone summoned to act and pushed to the edge of sanity.
explanation.definitionFit: Deranged means insane or unhinged, past participle like driven mad.

clue.text: Seat wrecked by sailors towards the rear

indicators.note: a wrecked word is broken up and its letters rebuilt in another order

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, the sailors

explanation.surface: Sailors have trashed a seat at the back of the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern is the nautical term for behind a ship, at or towards the back.
